forum.title: Can't include custom source file
forum.best_answer_content: If it's like other families, you should only include the top-level "stm32wlxx\_hal.h", and not individual HAL files.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I wrote my own source file. It is located in the Core/Src directory. I have also entered it accordingly in cmakelists.txt.

![my cmakelists.txt](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0b4a7af5-caf3-3849-7524-c593eb1ce9ec.png "Bildschirmfoto vom 2026-03-02 09-43-10.png")my cmakelists.txt

Now I get an error saying that the include files from the Drivers directory are missing.

![Bildschirmfoto vom 2026-03-02 09-45-19.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/76c3e9f0-bad3-b788-0bfe-5ce4b69ef1c1.png "Bildschirmfoto vom 2026-03-02 09-45-19.png")

If I remove my entry, I no longer get the error. But then I can't use my customs. Is there a sample cmakelists.txt that includes customs?

Thank you,

Funnypinky
forum.author: Funnypinky

scraped_replies.html:
hi @Funnypinky 

for me seems an include issue, how did you manage the includes in your custom file please ?
scraped_replies.author: Nawres GHARBI

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @Nawres GHARBI ,

i include the 

    stm32wlxx_hal_def.h
 
think you i must include the another files?
scraped_replies.author: Funnypinky

scraped_replies.html: If it's like other families, you should only include the top-level "stm32wlxx_hal.h", and not individual HAL files.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: Thank you, was a little mistake, but a big search.
scraped_replies.author: Funnypinky

scraped_replies.html: You should modify it to Core/Src/ina226/ina226.c
